newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing early Apr French wheat around $160.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing early Apr French wheat around $160.

text.p: A European Union award of 480,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 9.30 Ecus per tonne, reported by traders, values a tonne of early April French wheat at $160.50 per tonne, Reuters calculates.

The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types, as well as depending on dollar and other variables used.
